name: Keep Showing Up Keychain
description: A small acrylic keychain with the phrase that keeps the creative process moving on difficult days.
care_instructions: Wipe gently with a soft dry cloth and keep away from prolonged heat.
image_alt_text: Orange and purple acrylic keychain with a keep showing up message
design_meaning: The compact frame shape is a reminder that one small step still belongs in the final timeline.
creator_recommendation: Jia Wei recommends this for fans who want a simple everyday reminder to keep creating.

name: Frame by Frame Keychain
description: A layered keychain inspired by the frames and playback marks of a beginner editor's workspace.
care_instructions: Wipe gently with a soft dry cloth and avoid strong solvents.
image_alt_text: Layered blue and purple frame-shaped keychain with playback marks
design_meaning: Each layer represents a moment of practice that becomes part of the larger story.
creator_recommendation: Jia Wei recommends this for editing learners who enjoy carrying a visual piece of their process.

name: Progress Bar Sticker Set
description: Six small stickers for laptops, notebooks, and editing folders, each celebrating a different stage of progress.
care_instructions: Apply to a clean dry surface and hand-wipe only when needed.
image_alt_text: Six colourful progress bar stickers arranged beside a notebook
design_meaning: The different progress bars make unfinished work feel visible, useful, and worth continuing.
creator_recommendation: Jia Wei recommends this for fans who like decorating their study setup with small creative cues.

name: Edit in Progress Acrylic Charm
description: A playful editing-timeline charm for a bag, pencil case, or camera pouch.
care_instructions: Wipe gently with a soft cloth and store away from sharp objects.
image_alt_text: Small acrylic charm shaped like an editing timeline with an orange marker
design_meaning: Edit in progress is an honest status, not an apology; learning takes time and the project is still moving.
creator_recommendation: Jia Wei recommends this for anyone who is still learning and does not want to pretend the process is perfect.

name: Creator Desk Magnet Set
description: Four illustrated magnets for notes, shot lists, and small wins on a creative workspace board.
care_instructions: Keep dry and wipe the laminated surface gently with a soft cloth.
image_alt_text: Four colourful creator desk magnets showing notes, frames, and progress marks
design_meaning: The set turns everyday planning into a visible record of small ideas becoming real work.
creator_recommendation: Jia Wei recommends this for fans who enjoy planning videos, study sessions, or personal projects.

name: Keep Showing Up Tee
description: A relaxed everyday tee with a quiet front mark and the core belief across the back.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold with similar colours and air dry when possible.
image_alt_text: Soft white cotton tee with a small frame mark on the front

Soft White.image_alt_text: Soft white cotton tee with a small frame mark on the front

Deep Blue.image_alt_text: Deep blue cotton tee with a small frame mark on the front

design_meaning: The simple front keeps the message close, while the back makes the belief visible when you keep moving forward.
creator_recommendation: Jia Wei recommends this as the easiest first piece for fans who want an everyday reminder without a loud graphic.

name: Work in Progress Tee
description: A comfortable tee with an editing status label for people learning in public and improving as they go.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold inside out and avoid high heat when drying.
image_alt_text: Deep blue cotton tee with a colourful work in progress label
design_meaning: The label treats learning as a current state with momentum, not a permanent measure of ability.
creator_recommendation: Jia Wei recommends this for fans who are building a skill, sharing early work, or starting again.

name: Frame by Frame Long Sleeve
description: A lightweight long-sleeve layer with small frame markers along the sleeve for edit days and cool evenings.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold and lay flat or hang dry to help preserve the shape.
image_alt_text: Creative purple long-sleeve top with small frame markers on one sleeve
design_meaning: The repeated frame marks show that progress is built from connected moments rather than one dramatic breakthrough.
creator_recommendation: Jia Wei recommends this for long editing sessions, study days, and fans who like subtle visual details.

name: Timeline Notes Hoodie
description: A soft hoodie with a small timeline note on the chest and a focused creator label at the hem.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold inside out and dry on low heat or air dry.
image_alt_text: Deep blue fleece hoodie with a small timeline note on the chest
design_meaning: Notes on a timeline are evidence of attention; the hoodie celebrates the quiet work behind a finished video.
creator_recommendation: Jia Wei recommends this for fans who prefer a calmer, more practical statement piece for work or study.

name: Small Steps Sweatpants
description: Relaxed sweatpants with a small progress marker near the pocket, made for comfortable creative routines.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold with similar colours and air dry for best results.
image_alt_text: Soft white relaxed sweatpants with a small orange progress marker near the pocket
design_meaning: The small marker keeps the focus on the next useful step instead of demanding a perfect result today.
creator_recommendation: Jia Wei recommends this for comfortable home editing, planning, and recovery-day routines.

name: Playback Cap
description: A casual adjustable cap with a small playback symbol for filming days, errands, and edit breaks.
care_instructions: Spot clean with a damp cloth and let the cap air dry naturally.
image_alt_text: Deep blue adjustable cotton cap with a small playback symbol
design_meaning: Playback is a chance to notice what worked, learn from what did not, and try the next cut with more clarity.
creator_recommendation: Jia Wei recommends this for fans who want the editing reference to stay small and wearable.

name: Edit Mode Dad Cap
description: A relaxed washed cap with an edit mode label for focused work sessions and everyday creator life.
care_instructions: Spot clean gently and avoid machine washing to protect the washed finish.
image_alt_text: Washed purple cotton dad cap with a small edit mode label
design_meaning: The edit mode label gives permission to focus on one small piece of work at a time.
creator_recommendation: Jia Wei recommends this for fans who like a softer, everyday silhouette while they study or create.

name: Frame Marker Beanie
description: A warm ribbed beanie with one bright frame marker woven into the cuff.
care_instructions: Hand wash gently in cool water and lay flat to dry.
image_alt_text: Soft white ribbed beanie with a bright orange frame marker on the cuff
design_meaning: The single marker is a small sign that even a quiet day can hold a moment worth keeping.
creator_recommendation: Jia Wei recommends this for fans who want a warm, subtle piece with one playful editing detail.
